theme_strategy.name: Acoustic Obsidian (Dark Studio Theme)
theme_strategy.description: A dark, highly-focused studio environment designed to reduce anxiety and enhance focus. Mimics a high-end recording booth using deep slate/obsidian bases, glowing amber/warm accents for active states, and calm sage for completions.
theme_strategy.mode: Dark mode primary (toggleable to Light mode, but optimize for Dark).

fonts.install_instruction: Add to index.html or import via @font-face/Google Fonts.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight font-medium text-white
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-medium text-white/90
hierarchy.karaoke_active: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-medium tracking-tight leading-tight text-white transition-all duration-300 transform scale-100
hierarchy.karaoke_inactive: text-2xl md:text-3xl font-medium tracking-normal leading-relaxed text-white/30 transition-all duration-500
hierarchy.karaoke_completed: text-2xl md:text-3xl font-medium tracking-normal leading-relaxed text-[#A3B19B]/40 transition-all duration-500

visual_enhancers.karaoke_focus: Use a subtle linear gradient mask (`mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, black 20%, black 80%, transparent)`) on the scrolling container to fade out text at the top and bottom edges.
visual_enhancers.recording_glow: When recording is active, add an absolute positioned `div` behind the mic icon with `bg-[#FFB067] blur-2xl opacity-40 animate-pulse`.
visual_enhancers.grid_lines: Dashboard uses an exposed skeleton grid layout (`border-collapse`) with subtle 1px borders (`border-white/10`) to feel like technical studio software.

layouts.dashboard: Mode B: High Density Bento Grid. Base: `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-6`. 'Continue Practice' hero card takes `col-span-1 md:col-span-3`, stats take `col-span-1`.
layouts.karaoke_screen: Immersive 100vh layout. Hidden header/footer. Lyrics vertically centered in the viewport. Controls contained in a bottom floating glassmorphism pill.

motion.lyric_scroll: Smooth continuous transition for vertical translation using `framer-motion`. Active line scales up slightly.
motion.controls_reveal: Controls pill slides up from bottom (`translate-y-0`) on mouse movement/pause, hides (`translate-y-24`) after a few seconds of active speaking.
motion.page_transitions: Fade and slight scale-up (`scale: 0.98` to `1.0`) on page load to feel deliberate and calm.

components_strategy.name: KaraokeTeleprompter
components_strategy.description: The hero component for the practice screen.
components_strategy.guidelines: Use `framer-motion` to animate the Y-axis translation of the sentence container based on the active index. Do not center align text horizontally—keep it left-aligned for natural reading, but vertically centered in the screen.

components_strategy.name: StudioControlPill
components_strategy.guidelines: Position `fixed bottom-8 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2`. Use Crystal Glassmorphism (`bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/20 saturate-150`). Contains Play/Pause, Restart, Next, Exit.

components_strategy.name: TopicBentoCard
components_strategy.guidelines: Flat background (`bg-[#121214]`), 1px subtle border (`border-[#27272A]`), no heavy drop shadow. Hover state: `-translate-y-1`, `border-white/30`, `bg-[#18181B]`.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure active karaoke text is purely white on deep black background.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements MUST have `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#FFB067] focus:outline-none focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-[#09090B]`.
accessibility.screen_readers: Provide `aria-live="polite"` regions for the timer and current sentence updates.

images.description: Warm lit microphone in studio. Use for the dashboard 'Quick Start' hero card background with a heavy `bg-black/60` overlay.
Dark abstract waves. Use as a very low opacity (10-15%) fixed background texture `mix-blend-overlay` for the entire app.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install custom fonts Outfit and Manrope before building UI.
Add tailwind configuration for custom colors and grid utilities.
Implement the layout with generic HTML tags (`main`, `section`, `nav`) using Tailwind classes, avoiding over-reliance on boxed Shadcn cards for the main layout.
Create the `data-testid` properties on all buttons and inputs immediately as you write the components.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: DO NOT use Inter or generic fonts for headings. Use Outfit for headings, Manrope for body text.
Do not use generic centered layouts for dashboards. Use the asymmetrical bento grid. The only element that should be vertically centered is the Karaoke practice screen.
DO NOT apply `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `transition-colors`, `transition-transform`, `transition-opacity`.
Every interactive element MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="start-practice-button"`).
NEVER use fully transparent backgrounds for floating elements (headers, dropdowns, sticky controls). Always use a blur and a semi-transparent dark color (e.g., `bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl`).
In the Karaoke practice mode, hide navigation bars. Make it a 100vh immersive experience.
Implement smooth scrolling using CSS (`scroll-behavior: smooth`) or `lenis` if complex scrolling is needed.
Avoid standard Bootstrap-like grids. Utilize negative space and generous padding (`p-6` to `p-12`) inside containers.
